name: cubby-ui
description: Framework-agnostic UI component library. Pure HTML + Tailwind CSS.

components.name: Button
components.notes: Always combine base + one variant class. Icon buttons: combine cu-button + cu-button-ghost + cu-button-icon. Add hover shadow for solid variants.

components.name: Card
components.notes: cu-card-hover: opt-in hover shadow (not default). cu-card-elevated: shadow-md. cu-card-content-flush: p-0 for table-in-card.

components.name: Separator
components.notes: REQUIRED: always add cu-separator-horizontal or cu-separator-vertical. Base class alone has no dimensions.

components.name: Textarea
components.notes: cu-textarea-auto uses field-sizing: content for auto-height (progressive enhancement).

components.name: Label
components.notes: cu-label-required adds a red asterisk via CSS ::after.

components.name: Select
components.notes: REQUIRED: wrap <select class="cu-select"> inside <div class="cu-select-wrapper"> for custom arrow decoration.

components.name: Checkbox
components.notes: REQUIRED: wrap input + label inside <div class="cu-checkbox-wrapper">. Uses custom SVG checkmark.

components.name: Radio
components.notes: REQUIRED: wrap input + label inside <div class="cu-radio-wrapper">. Custom dot style.

components.name: Toggle
components.notes: CSS-only. Uses hidden checkbox + sibling label selector. REQUIRED: wrap inside cu-toggle-wrapper.

components.name: Search Input
components.notes: REQUIRED: wrap inside cu-search-input-wrapper for search icon.

components.name: Number Input
components.notes: Use native <input type="number"> with min/max/step. Buttons use data-cu-number-decrement / data-cu-number-increment.

components.name: Combobox
components.notes: Add hidden attribute to content initially. Active item gets cu-combobox-item-active class. Shares listbox CSS with Multi Select. Search filters on every keystroke by default; optional data-cu-combobox-debounce="300" on the root delays filtering by N ms (clearing the query, arrow keys and Enter apply pending filtering immediately). Fires cu:combobox:change ({ value, item }) on selection and cu:combobox:search ({ query }) when the applied query changes (hook remote search here).

components.name: Multi Select
components.notes: Each item needs data-cu-value for tag rendering. Add hidden to content initially. Search filters on every keystroke by default; optional data-cu-multi-select-debounce="300" on the root delays filtering by N ms (clearing the query, arrow keys and Enter apply pending filtering immediately). Fires cu:multiselect:change ({ selected }) on selection and cu:multiselect:search ({ query }) when the applied query changes (hook remote search here).

components.name: Dropzone
components.notes: cu-dropzone-active class auto-toggled on drag. Click on zone triggers file input.
components.example: Drop files here

components.name: Transfer List
components.notes: data-cu-transfer-panel values: 'left' or 'right'. data-cu-transfer-check-all, count, search use 'left'/'right' values matching panel.

components.name: Accordion
components.notes: CSS-driven via native <details> open attribute. No JS needed. Bordered variant adds individual borders per item.

components.name: Avatar
components.notes: Fallback shows when image fails to load. Status indicator: add cu-avatar-status + one status variant.

components.name: Collapsible
components.notes: CSS-driven via native <details>.

components.name: Data Table
components.notes: Enhanced table with sorting, filtering, row selection. cu-data-table-striped adds alternating row backgrounds. Expandable rows via data-cu-data-table-expandable on container and data-cu-expand-row on trigger buttons.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Wrap table in cu-table-wrapper for overflow handling. Add cu-table-stacked for mobile card layout (requires data-label on each td).

components.name: Timeline
components.notes: cu-timeline-horizontal for horizontal step layout. cu-timeline-alternating for centered alternating left-right layout. Astro components available for typed props (variant, size, etc.).
components.example:

2h ago

components.name: Tree View
components.notes: Uses native <details>/<summary> for expand/collapse. cu-tree-leaf-active highlights the selected node. cu-tree-relaxed adds slightly more spacing between items and within nodes.

components.name: Alert
components.notes: cu-alert-accent adds a prominent filled emphasis (full border + tinted background) for stronger visual. Expandable alerts use data-cu-alert-expandable with data-cu-alert-expand-trigger and data-cu-alert-expandable-content.

components.name: Progress
components.notes: Set width via inline style or Tailwind on cu-progress-bar.

components.name: Skeleton
components.notes: cu-skeleton = pulse animation. cu-skeleton-shimmer = sweep animation. Set dimensions via inline style or Tailwind.

components.name: Spinner
components.notes: Default size determined by font-size context. cu-spinner-lg uses thicker border (border-[3px]). Color classes set text-color which drives border-current.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: Container auto-created at bottom-right if not in DOM. Default duration: 5000ms. Default max stack: 5. data-cu-toast-variant values: default | destructive | success | warning | info. Programmatic API: CubbyUI.toast.show({ title, description, variant, duration }) and CubbyUI.toast.promise(asyncFn, { loading, success, error }) for async operations.

components.name: Alert Dialog
components.notes: Uses native <dialog>. Does NOT close on backdrop click (intentional for blocking confirmation). trigger value must match <dialog id>.

components.name: Dialog
components.notes: Uses native <dialog>. Closes on backdrop click. trigger value must match <dialog id>. Default size: cu-dialog-md.

components.name: Drawer
components.notes: Uses native <dialog>. Default direction: cu-drawer-right. trigger value must match <dialog id>.

components.notes: Add hidden attribute to content initially. Closes on outside click.

components.name: Popover

components.name: Segmented Control
components.notes: Two usage modes: (1) Button-based — toggle cu-segmented-item-active class via JS. (2) Radio-based — use hidden cu-segmented-input (radio) + cu-segmented-item (label); JS auto-toggles cu-segmented-item-active on change. cu-segmented-block makes items fill full width.

components.name: Tabs
components.notes: trigger and content values must match. Default active tab: add cu-tabs-trigger-active to trigger and DO NOT add hidden to its content. Add hidden to all inactive content panels.

components.name: Container
components.notes: Base class only sets mx-auto + padding. Always combine with a size class.

components.name: Filter Bar
Header
components.notes: cu-header-nav is always visible by default; add cu-header-nav-{sm|md|lg|xl} to hide below a breakpoint. cu-header-nav-start: nav aligned left (after brand). cu-header-nav-end: nav aligned right (before actions). Header is sticky by default. Mobile nav: slide-in panel from the right with backdrop, auto-clones desktop nav when data-cu-mobile-nav-clone is set. The panel/backdrop are display:none when closed (fully removed from the a11y tree, animated open via @starting-style) and carry the hidden attribute by default to prevent FOUC before CSS loads (JS removes it on open). Add cu-header-mobile-nav-{bp} + cu-header-mobile-backdrop-{bp} (matching the trigger's breakpoint) to fully remove them on desktop. Supports Escape key, backdrop click, scroll lock, focus management.

components.name: Scroll Area
components.notes: Set explicit height (or max-height) for vertical scroll. cu-scroll-area-horizontal enables horizontal scroll.

components.name: Sidebar
components.notes: Two-level hierarchy: cu-sidebar-section (top label, uppercase) > cu-sidebar-group (sub-group, bold) > cu-sidebar-item (link).

components.name: Chat Bubble
components.notes: Use cu-chat-bubble-user for right-aligned user messages (primary bg) and cu-chat-bubble-assistant for left-aligned AI messages (muted bg). Actions are always visible.

components.name: Chat Input
components.notes: Auto-growing textarea with field-sizing: content. Send button supports disabled state. Attach button is optional.

components.name: Chat Typing
components.notes: Animated bouncing dots indicator. Place inside cu-chat-bubble-content alongside cu-chat-bubble-avatar for contextual display.

components.name: Aspect Ratio
components.notes: Children are absolutely positioned to fill the container. Always combine base + one ratio class. Child elements get object-cover by default.

components.name: Carousel
components.notes: Uses CSS scroll-snap for smooth slide transitions. Prev/next buttons auto-disable at edges. cu-carousel-multi-2 / cu-carousel-multi-3 show 2 or 3 slides at a time. Dots auto-sync with scroll position. Respects prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Checkbox Group
components.notes: Select-all checkbox automatically toggles all items. Supports indeterminate state when some items are checked. cu-checkbox-group-selectall adds bottom border separator.
components.example: Options

components.name: Code Block
components.notes: Code container with optional header (language label) and copy button. Default dark theme; add cu-code-block-light for light variant. Copy button can be absolute (no header) or inline (inside header). Copied state applied via data-cu-copied attribute. Set language-xxx class on <code> element for third-party syntax highlighting (Prism.js / Highlight.js).

components.name: Color Picker
components.notes: HSV-based color picker with saturation panel, hue slider, hex input, and optional preset swatches. Supports drag interaction on saturation panel and hue bar. Initial value via data-cu-color-picker-value or hidden input value. Swatch colors set via data-cu-color-picker-swatch attribute.

components.name: Command Palette
components.notes: Uses native <dialog> with showModal(). Opens with Ctrl/Cmd+K globally. Supports keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/Down, Enter). Filters items by text content or data-cu-command-value. Groups auto-hide when all items are filtered out. Active item highlighted via data-cu-command-active attribute. Closes on backdrop click.

components.name: Context Menu
components.notes: Right-click triggered context menu. Content is positioned at cursor location. Auto-closes on click, Escape, scroll, or right-click outside. Uses cu-dropdown-item / cu-dropdown-separator for menu items (shared styles). Add hidden attribute to content initially.

components.name: Date Picker
components.notes: Two components: standalone Calendar and Date Picker (input + popover calendar). Calendar renders month grid with keyboard navigation (arrow keys). Date constraints via data-cu-calendar-min / data-cu-calendar-max (YYYY-MM-DD format). Date Picker stores ISO date in hidden input, displays formatted date in trigger.
components.example: Su

components.name: Input Group
components.notes: Groups input with addon text/icons. Children border-radius flattened; first-child gets rounded-l-lg, last-child gets rounded-r-lg. Negative margin (-ml-px) prevents double borders. Use cu-input inside the group for the input field.

components.name: Password Input
components.notes: Password field with show/hide toggle button. Toggle switches input type between password and text. Icon elements (show/hide) are toggled via display:none. Place two icon elements inside the toggle button, one with data-cu-password-icon-show (visible when type=password) and one with data-cu-password-icon-hide (visible when type=text, initially hidden).

components.name: Pin Input
components.notes: OTP / verification code input. Each field accepts one character, auto-advances on input. Backspace moves to previous field. Supports paste across all fields. Set data-cu-pin-input-type="numeric" to restrict to digits only.

components.name: Resizable Panels
components.notes: Drag-to-resize panel layout. Default is horizontal (col-resize); add cu-resizable-vertical for vertical (row-resize). Panel sizes controlled via flex-grow, auto-distributed equally on init. Handles support mouse, touch, and keyboard (arrow keys, step=5). Min/max constraints via data-cu-min-size / data-cu-max-size (percentage values). data-cu-resizing attribute set on handle during active drag.

components.name: Toggle Group
components.notes: Switchable button group. Single selection by default; add data-cu-toggle-group-multiple for multi-select. Outline variant for bordered style. Fires cu:toggle-group:change event.

components.name: Rating
components.notes: Star rating component. Use cu-rating-readonly for display-only, data-cu-rating for interactive. Half stars via cu-rating-item-half with CSS clip-path. Fires cu:rating:change event.
components.example: ★★★

components.name: Tag Input
components.notes: Tag/chip input with Enter to add and Backspace to remove. Prevents duplicate tags. Max tags limit via data-cu-tag-max. Fires cu:tag-input:change event.
components.example: Tag

components.name: Marquee
components.notes: Infinite scrolling content (logo walls, testimonials). Pure CSS animation, no JS needed. Duplicate cu-marquee-content (with aria-hidden) for seamless loop. Speed via --cu-marquee-duration CSS variable (default: 30s).

components.name: Sortable List
components.notes: Drag-and-drop reorderable list using native HTML Drag and Drop API. Items must have draggable="true". Fires cu:sortable:change event with new order. Disabled items via cu-sortable-item-disabled.

components.name: Countdown
components.notes: Countdown timer to a target ISO date. Auto-updates every second. Fires cu:countdown:complete when done. Use cu-countdown-flush for minimal look.

components.name: Image Compare
components.notes: Before/after image comparison slider. Drag handle to reveal. Position controlled via --cu-compare-position CSS variable. Supports touch events.

components.name: Floating Label
components.notes: Material Design-style floating label. Input MUST have placeholder=" " (space) for CSS :placeholder-shown to work. Label must come after input in DOM.

components.name: Notification
components.notes: Static notification cards for activity feeds and notification panels. For floating alerts, use Toast instead. Unread state via cu-notification-unread.

components.name: Speed Dial
components.notes: Floating action button with expandable actions. Click trigger to toggle. Closes on outside click. Staggered animation on actions. Trigger rotates 45deg when open.

components.name: Back to Top
components.notes: Scroll-to-top button. Auto shows/hides based on scroll position. Default threshold: 300px, customizable via data-cu-back-to-top-threshold. Smooth scrolls to top on click.

components.name: Diff Viewer
components.notes: Code diff viewer with unified or side-by-side layout. Lines use ::before pseudo for +/- prefix. Word-level highlighting via inline spans.

components.name: Kanban
components.notes: Drag-and-drop kanban board. Cards move between columns via native HTML DnD. Auto-updates column counts. Fires cu:kanban:change event.

components.name: Tour
components.notes: Guided tour overlay. Steps defined as JSON array in data-cu-tour-steps. Each step: { target, title, description, placement }. Auto-start via data-cu-tour-auto or programmatic via cu:tour:start event. Fires cu:tour:complete when done.
